chunks: And it is narrated from Muʿammar ibn Khallād, from al-Riḍā عليه السلام, who said:
I heard him saying: “Three things are from the sunnah (prophetic tradition) of the messengers: perfume, removing hair closely, and frequent intercourse.”
ai.seo_question: What practices are described as being from the sunnah (prophetic tradition) of the messengers in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that three practices belong to the sunnah (prophetic tradition) of the messengers: using perfume, removing hair, and frequent marital relations. It presents these as established prophetic traits connected to personal grooming and married life.
